name: Ring of the Mole
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 4th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of far sight. Once worn, however, the wearer’s distance vision becomes impaired, imparting a -5 penalty to Perception checks and an additional cumulative -2 penalty to all range increments beyond short. The wearer does gain a +2 to Disable Device checks.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse, followed by true seeing, upon it, which renders the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of far sight

Identification DC 29
False Identification DC 19
